column1: # The promise of permanence (docs/site-map.md §6) starts when the site is announced. Until then any row below, whatever its status, may be renamed or removed.
# columns: name, kind, status, within, expression, element, value, parameters, measures, aliases, plural, show, oeis, findstat, requested_by, date
# kind: collection | subcollection. status: proposed | reserved | stub | live.
# name: PascalCase, singular, the noun for one member (PerfectNumber; the adjective alone, Perfect, is an alias). within: the collection a subcollection sits inside.
# expression: the Epsil behind the collection, its plural head, with the parameters as its variables; where different sets of parameters can be bound, one form for each, separated by ` | `.
# element: the constructor of one element, in Epsil, over x (the value written in the address) and any parameter an element cannot be written without.
# value: how an element is written in an address: integer | ordered | parts | digits | unordered | blocks (site map §2.5). show: the properties a page leads with, comma-separated.
# Every head named in expression, element and show is checked against the pinned notatio by a test.
# parameters: `-` for none, else `|`-separated; each is `word`, then `*` on the one that n and a bare value bind, then `[alias,alias]`.
# measures: for a parameter that an element determines, `word=Epsil over x`, `|`-separated: how the kernel places an element in its collection when the address binds nothing.
# aliases and the plural exception: comma-separated; the default plural is a trailing s.
# oeis and findstat: the outside identifier of the collection (its count, or its triangle), when one is known.
